entries.body:
These blocks behave just like the Copycats you know and love, except you can also send a different redstone signal to each side! 

 Take the 6 character alphanumric string from one menu, paste it into the other menu, and thats it! Figuring out the side can be a little confusing at first, and I will tell you now that assembling/dissassembling swapped the faces for me in one test. I'm still working that out.

 Hover over the image below to learn more about the 2 Wireless Copycat Menus. The first image is the "Keyboard-side" menu, while the second image is the "Copycat-side" menu.
